description: Payhip is a digital products storefront. This plugin creates and manages discount coupons with the account API key, and verifies, enables, disables and counts software license keys with the per-product secret key. Coupon bodies are form-encoded as the API requires.

api.description: Create a discount coupon for one product, all products or a collection

fields.description: Code the customer enters at checkout
Percentage discount; required unless amount_off is passed
Fixed discount in cents; required unless percent_off is passed
Product key; required when coupon_type is single
Collection id; required when coupon_type is collection
Minimum cart total in cents before redemption
Administrative note, not visible to customers

fields.type: { id: number, code?: string | null, coupon_type?: single | multi | collection | string | null, percent_off?: number | null, amount_off?: number | null, start_date?: string | null, end_date?: string | null, product_key?: string | null, collection_id?: string | null, minimum_purchase_amount?: number | null, usage_limit?: number | null, notes?: string | null }
